title: Performance Legging
subtitle: Red high waist / white contrast side panels
status: PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT SPECIFICATION — SAMPLE VALIDATION REQUIRED
fit: Close fit with proposed 13.5% waist and 14.3% hip negative ease at EU 38; not a tested compression claim.
market: Adult Womenswear / EU-labelled development range; no UK conversion implied

bom.specification: PROPOSED compact interlock, 240–280 g/m²; ≥65% crosswise and ≥40% length extension; ≤5% residual growth after agreed recovery trial
bom.placement: Legs, rear yokes, two-layer waistband, gusset

bom.specification: Same weight/extension/recovery class as F01; opacity/colour migration trial mandatory
10 mm soft knitted elastic; ≥70% usable extension without damage; 62 cm finished ring, cut 64 cm incl. 2 cm overlap at EU 38
Polyester needle Tex 24, soft textured polyester loopers; ballpoint Nm 75–80 trial
PROPOSED low-temperature soft transfer; migration/stretch trials; care content pending
bom.placement: Inside CB waistband, below top elastic

bom.specification: Keep red/white surfaces separated during damp transit test; fold after cooling

operations.method: Join waistband rings at CB with 6 mm SA / 514, 3 mm stitch. Enclose E01 at folded top without twisting. Finished height 9 cm. Attach lower band edge to legs, 6 mm SA / 514; quarters matched, no feed distortion.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Superimposed seam 6 mm SA, 514 four-thread overedge, 3 mm stitch, allowance toward red. Optional seam-cover row is not specified in this issue; do not call this flatlock. Match hip/knee/hem notches on both colours.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Diamond gusset F01, finished tip-to-tip 12 × 7 cm at base size. Insert with 6 mm SA / 514, 2.8 mm; needle-down pivot without cutting tip. Orient greatest stretch across body; no visible exterior outline claimed from source.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Turn 20 mm, 406 two-needle coverseam / 4 mm gauge, 3 mm stitch. Needle thread tension must allow ≥40% seam extension without pop. No gripper or zip.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: PROPOSED seam mapping of visible rear curve. Join yoke to back leg 6 mm SA / 514, 3 mm; match across CB. No darts. Check curve sits below waistband and does not create seat pressure ridge.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: CB/CF and inseams 6 mm SA / 514, 2.8–3 mm. Gusset inserted before final inseam closure; no four-seam pile at crotch. Stretch test every seam direction after conditioning.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Overlap E01 ends 20 mm; secure with two 304 zigzag rows, 3 mm width × 2 mm length. Proposed ring 62 cm relaxed; working circumference must reach ≥100 cm without damage or stitch break.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Apply L01 inside CB on waistband inner layer before closing, below elastic. Transfer temperature/dwell TBD by supplier trial. No reproduction of the photographed sports logo.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

poms.name: Waist relaxed
poms.method: Top edge flat, 24 h relaxed, no tension.

poms.name: Waist extended minimum
poms.method: Extend uniformly until 100 cm full circumference at base size without damage; value is half of minimum pass-over target, not maximum stretch.

poms.name: Hip width relaxed
poms.method: 20 cm below waistband top, parallel to waist.

poms.name: Front rise incl. waistband
poms.method: Follow CF from band top to gusset front/crotch junction; contour, not straight chord.

poms.name: Inseam
poms.method: From crotch datum at gusset centre to finished hem along inseam; include half gusset longitudinal contribution.

poms.name: Thigh width
poms.method: 25 mm below crotch datum, perpendicular to grain.

poms.name: Knee width
poms.method: 32 cm below crotch along inseam; width perpendicular to leg grain.

poms.name: Leg opening
poms.method: Lay one leg flat without tension; measure edge to edge along the finished hem, perpendicular to leg grain.

poms.name: Back rise incl. waistband
poms.method: Follow CB curve band top to gusset centre/crotch datum.

poms.name: Waistband finished height
poms.method: At side, top fold to lower attachment seam.

poms.name: Outseam incl. waistband
poms.method: Along outer leg/panel centre from top to hem.

poms.name: Contrast panel width at knee
poms.method: Across white panel at knee datum, finished seam to seam.

poms.name: Gusset finished length
poms.method: Removed flat component: front tip to rear tip on seam line.

poms.name: Gusset finished width
poms.method: Removed flat component: widest side tip to opposite tip on seam line.

details: Double self layer; 10 mm elastic inside top fold; 20 mm overlap; passage target checked at 100 cm full base circumference.
12 × 7 cm finished seam-line component; 6 mm SA added outside; stretch direction across width.
514 superimposed panel join, allowances toward red; 20 mm turned hem secured with 406. No false flatlock claim.
pattern: Front legs ×2, back legs ×2, rear yokes ×2, contrast panels ×2 mirrored, outer/inner waistband each ×1, gusset ×1. All PROPOSED; walk curved yoke seam and gusset interfaces.
Greatest stretch around hip/waist; align red/white stretch axes. No pocket, zip or logo artwork.
Base waist 64/74 cm = −13.5%; hip 84/98 = −14.3%. These are development ratios, not measured compression; approve fit after material tests.
assembly: Condition knit 24 h; compare red/white extension and laundering response.
Cut mirrored panels/yokes, mark knee/hip/gusset notches and stretch direction.
Join rear yokes, then contrast panels to front/back legs.
Join rise; insert diamond gusset; close remaining inseams without stacked crotch bulk.
Join elastic and waistband rings; apply transfer to inner band after heat trial.
Enclose elastic; attach double waistband with quarter matching.
Coverseam hems; cool and relax before fit/measurement.
qc: White panel opacity at squat and wet condition; no red dye migration.
Five cycles to 50% extension, hold 10 s each; after 30 min recovery residual growth ≤5% as proposed screening method, not a certified standard.
Waist passes 100 cm full base circumference without damage; returns to relaxed POM within tolerance after 30 min.
Seams extend ≥40% without pop; no tunnelling or gusset tip holes.
Left/right panel widths and knee notches match; no twisted leg after wash trial.
risks: Negative ease cannot be released for production without actual fabric force/extension/recovery and wearer tests.
Rear yoke/gusset are proposed and may need remapping after physical sample.
Sublimation/migration and transfer damage must be assessed on selected red/white fabrics.
evidence: CONFIRMED in source: red leggings, deep red waistband, wide white side panels, curved rear seam lines and ankle-length hem. Sports bra and footwear are excluded.
No pocket is visible; no pocket specified. Source logo is excluded from all new production artwork; ABERBACH credits documentation only.
Gusset and top-waist elastic are PROPOSED internal development decisions, not visible confirmed components.
assumptions: PROPOSED front/back legs with separate contrast side panels and small diamond gusset for mobility; shape requires fit trial.
Waistband is proposed double self fabric with 10 mm elastic at top inside fold; stretch must allow garment to pass 98 cm base hip.
Curved rear line engineered as a yoke seam only as a proposal; source appearance does not prove seam section.
consumption: ESTIMATE: red shell 1.00–1.20 m at 150 cm usable width; white contrast 0.25–0.35 m at 150 cm, EU 38. Paired legs/yokes + two-layer waistband + gusset; greatest stretch around body; non-directional; 15% relaxation/cutting reserve. Contrast nested in separate colour marker. Verify marker and shrinkage before costing.
care: TBD: fibre identity, component compatibility, care testing, country of origin and destination-market legal review. Do not print generic care symbols.
labels: PROPOSED: 35 × 12 mm soft ID/size heat transfer inside CB waistband below the elastic, plus compatible care transfer with content withheld until verified. Confirm temperature, dwell, migration and stretch before application. No sewn 301 label or third-party logo.
packaging: PROPOSED: fold only after cooling; use unprinted recyclable protective sleeve sized to the actual folded sample. Bag material, gauge and dimensions TBD after packing trial. One garment per sleeve; no invented approved bag size.
